description: Stage-2 (B) pre-registered statistics plan. TEMPLATE: every input path is a placeholder and must be replaced before lock_plan(); relative paths resolve against this file's directory. A family must be endpoint-homogeneous; classification AUROC comparisons use the classification endpoint and are never mixed with the XAI endpoints (localization, sanity, faithfulness). Every saliency_paired comparison also registers `p_method`, never leaving the choice to SciPy's `auto`: `approx` is the explicit normal approximation for large cohorts (more than 20 pairs, e.g. n=498), `permutation` is the exhaustive 2^n sign-flip test on the tie-averaged signed ranks for small continuous cohorts (n<=20 non-zero differences, requires zero_method wilcox), and `mcnemar_exact` is the two-sided exact binomial on the discordant pairs of a binary 0/1 hit metric. Both template cohorts below are SIIM holdout cohorts larger than 20 images and the PTX-498 cohort is 498 pairs, so those image-unit comparisons register `approx`. The last two families are the patient-level templates: `uncertainty_unit` = patient plus `inputs.patient_manifest` (a frozen image_id/patient_id manifest) resamples patients instead of images, and the saliency comparison then tests one mean difference per patient, so the CheXlocalize XAI cohort (15 patients) registers `permutation`. Families cover E1 (SIIM holdout), E2 (VinDr: all 18,000 images, plus the 3,000-image official-test subset as a second comparison of the same prediction files), E3 (PTX-498 saliency localization) and E4 (CheXlocalize); the secondary E5 runs are outside the A↔B analysis and are not registered here.
